_about: Oria insights panels (includes/facet-insights.php): figures Oria Haven worked out from details checked on each venue's own website or the booking page it links to. Keyed by facet URL slug. 'checked' is the date of the check; panels older than 183 days are hidden, so re-check and bump the date. 'snapshot' replaces the hero's 'Typical published price' on that page. Never fill a figure from a listing's generic price_from. Source research for the sauna panels: D:/OriaHaven/drafts/saunas/sauna-prices-checked-2026-10-07.json.

_method.typical: Median of single-person, sauna-only prices for that session length, one price per venue. Pods and multi-therapy rooms (Element, Active Wellness) and sauna-plus-ice-bath bundles excluded.
_method.cheapest_for_two: Lowest published two-person price for the shortest common session.
_method.river: North or south of the Swan River by the venue's suburb.
_method.private: Venues whose own site says sessions are private or the cabin is your own; 'not stated' is not counted either way.
_method.lengths: Count of venues offering each session length, out of venues with a working website.
_method.amenities: Showers, Sunday hours and towels from venues' own sites or the booking page they link to (D:/OriaHaven/drafts/saunas/sauna-amenities-checked-2026-10-07.json). Excluded where the source contradicts itself or only mentions the feature for another service: Merse's showers are a circuit feature; Recovery Haus and The Neighbourhood Sauna give conflicting towel answers; Rhema's and Salt Float's showers are for float rooms only.

pottery.basis: prices published by 8 Perth pottery studios on their own websites or booking pages

items.label: One-off taster
items.note: Three hours on the wheel at ClayMake, Maylands. Six studios run a taster; range $80–$149.

items.label: Beginner course
items.note: Four to eight weekly classes. Cheapest by the hour: Canning Arts Group, $345 for 24 hours (clay and firing extra), and Fremantle Arts Centre, $394 with clay included.

items.label: Ready to collect
items.note: Pieces are dried, fired and glazed after the class.

items.label: Open studio
items.note: Studio P, three-month minimum. ClayMake $105 a month; Hound Ceramics $220 a month.

items.label: Booked out
items.note: On 13 October Studio P’s intro workshops were sold out to late November and Porch Ceramics’ October courses were full.

method: One-off taster and beginner course prices as each studio publishes them; private bookings and kids’ classes are left out.
Where a studio doesn't say something, it is counted as not stated -- never as no.
Prices, inclusions and availability change. Check the studio’s own site before you book.
